title: Put the e2e suite, with axe, into CI
goal: The Playwright e2e (including axe) runs on every PR, which also closes dormant check T3
acceptance: `ci.yml` installs the Playwright browser and runs `npm run e2e`; the existing flaky feed e2e (B-008) stays reliable over three consecutive runs
The coverage table and the CI step list name the suite
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: One workflow step, a browser install and three green runs; the e2e is not in CI today, so first runs may expose environment differences. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
